gen-gf-jim-nightshade-fs-epilogue: Epilogue brings curvy, wire-thin monoline letters with stubby ascender tips, a sans-serif made for quick visits rather than marathons. Jim Nightshade, loose and casual, earns its keep when big and brief.
gen-gf-mali-fs-recia: Loose handwriting meets a sharp serif. Mali keeps the top casual and inviting, while Recia, a text serif whose light modulation shows mostly up close, adds sharp authority below.
